svg.title: The order it was built in, October 2026
svg.desc: October 19: one static page with Blender mannequin clips. October 21: printable PDFs, and a spec for a rebuild in Next.js. October 22: the exercise library with 582 licensed clips, CI, the Supabase schema with row-level security, sign-in on the server, and the move to Cloudflare Workers. October 23: plan editor, coaching, progress charts and logging without signal. October 24: consent and privacy, rate limits, shared plan codes and email-code sign-in. October 25: share management and one-transaction deletes.
svg.text: The order it was built in
Commit dates, Tokyo time, October 2026. 64 pull requests merged by the morning of the 25th.
Oct 19
One static page
A weekly plan, form cards and a checklist. The moves are grey mannequins rendered in Blender.
Oct 21
Printable PDFs, then a spec for the rebuild
Paper plans to use in the gym while the real thing is written down first.
Oct 22
Next.js, 582 licensed clips, Supabase, Workers
Exercise library and CI. Schema with RLS and database tests. Google sign-in on the server.
Moved from a static export to Cloudflare Workers. Onboarding, plan generator, logging API.
Oct 23
Coaching, progress, logging without signal
Plan editor, profile pictures, invite links, charts, the outbox and the service worker.
Oct 24
Privacy, limits, sharing, a second way to sign in
Consent and age check, rate limits and an audit log, plan share codes, 6-digit email codes.
Resume a workout, fix or delete past sets, swap an exercise when its machine isn't there.
Oct 25
Finishing what was half done
Stop every share from one list, count code tries per address, delete a workout in one transaction.
